Machine chest press.name: Leverage Chest Press
Machine chest press.cue: Adjust the seat so handles sit around mid-chest. Keep feet planted and shoulder blades against the pad; press smoothly without locking elbows.

Seated cable row.name: Seated Cable Rows
Seated cable row.cue: Sit tall with a neutral back. Pull the handle toward your lower ribs without rocking; return with control.

Lat pulldown.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
Lat pulldown.cue: Secure the thigh pad. Pull toward the upper chest with elbows down; do not yank the handle behind your neck.

Dumbbell shoulder press.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
Dumbbell shoulder press.cue: Set a stable back-supported seat. Keep ribs down and wrists over elbows. Press only through a comfortable range.

Cable triceps pressdown.name: Triceps Pushdown
Cable triceps pressdown.cue: Keep elbows beside your ribs. Straighten the elbows without swinging the torso; return slowly.

Dumbbell biceps curl.name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
Dumbbell biceps curl.cue: Keep upper arms still. Curl without rocking; lower slowly. The photo shows a seated version of the same curl.

Leg press.name: Leg Press
Leg press.cue: Keep the entire foot on the platform. Lower only as far as your hips and back stay on the pad; avoid locking knees.

Dumbbell Romanian deadlift.name: Romanian Deadlift
Dumbbell Romanian deadlift.cue: The photo uses a barbell: use dumbbells beside your legs for this plan. Soften knees, push hips back, keep the weights close, and stop before your back rounds.

Seated leg curl.name: Seated Leg Curl
Seated leg curl.cue: Align knees with the machine pivot and secure the thigh pad. Curl heels down and back without lifting your hips.

Leg extension.name: Leg Extensions
Leg extension.cue: Align knees with the machine pivot; pad rests just above ankles. Straighten smoothly without snapping your knees.

Calf raise machine.name: Standing Calf Raises
Calf raise machine.cue: Use support, keep knees soft, and raise heels smoothly. Lower under control; avoid bouncing at the bottom.

Pallof press.name: Pallof Press
Pallof press.cue: Stand sideways to a chest-height cable. Brace your torso, press hands straight out, and resist rotation. Complete both sides.

Incline dumbbell press.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
Incline dumbbell press.cue: Set a modest bench incline. Plant feet, keep shoulder blades supported, and press without flaring elbows or bouncing.

Chest-supported row.name: Dumbbell Incline Row
Chest-supported row.cue: Support your chest on an incline bench. Pull elbows back without lifting your chest from the pad; lower smoothly.

Neutral-grip lat pulldown.name: V-Bar Pulldown
Neutral-grip lat pulldown.cue: Use a palms-facing attachment. Secure thighs, pull elbows toward your ribs, and avoid leaning far back.

Lateral raise.name: Side Lateral Raise
Lateral raise.cue: Use light dumbbells with soft elbows. Raise arms out to about shoulder height without shrugging or swinging.

Face pull.name: Face Pull
Face pull.cue: Set the rope near face height. Pull toward your forehead, separating the rope ends. Keep ribs down and use a light load.

Cable curl.name: Standing Biceps Cable Curl
Cable curl.cue: Keep elbows beside your torso. Curl the low cable handle with no torso swing, then lower slowly.

Rope pressdown.name: Triceps Pushdown - Rope Attachment
Rope pressdown.cue: Keep elbows still by your ribs; extend and separate the rope slightly at the bottom. Pair with cable curls as prescribed.

Goblet squat or leg press.name: Goblet Squat
Goblet squat or leg press.cue: Photo shows goblet squat. Hold a dumbbell at the chest, keep heels planted, and squat to a comfortable depth. Leg press is the other programmed option.

Hip thrust or glute bridge.name: Butt Lift (Bridge)
Hip thrust or glute bridge.cue: Photo shows the floor glute-bridge option. Place feet flat, brace your abdomen, and lift hips by squeezing glutes without arching your lower back.

Leg curl.name: Seated Leg Curl
Leg curl.cue: Photo shows seated leg curl; use a comfortable leg-curl machine. Align your knees with its pivot and keep hips still.

Dumbbell step-up (low step).name: Dumbbell Step Ups
Dumbbell step-up (low step).cue: Use a low, stable step. Place the full foot on it and drive through the leading leg. Step down slowly; do both legs. Begin without weights if needed.

Farmer carry.name: Farmer's Walk
Farmer carry.cue: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides and walk with controlled, short steps. Keep shoulders level and breathe. Log seconds, not reps.

Plank.name: Plank
Plank.cue: Place elbows under shoulders. Brace abdomen and glutes so your body stays straight; breathe normally. End before your hips sag. Log seconds.
